content: Adafeɛ n Bulus x yixef nnes zzat i řgens
... “A tawmat d ibabaten, sřem i min d awem ɣa iniɣ x udafeɛ inu.”
Umi sřin, aqa issawař akidsen s yiřes n Tɛibranit, qqimen sqaren ɛad ktar. Inna asen:

“Necc d ijj n bnadem d Uday, xeřqeɣ-dd di Tarsus di Kilikiya, maca arebbiɣ di tendint-a ɣar iḍaren n Gamaliyal u ttwassřemdeɣ ɛlaḥsab tidett nican n Ccariɛa n řejdud nneɣ. Ceṭṭareɣ x min iǧan n AREBBI am mammec uřa d kenniw marra.
Necc tuɣa ḍeffareɣ Abrid-a s řmewt am carrfeɣ iryazen d temɣarin, ttsellameɣ ten ɣar řeḥbes.
Arrays n ikehhanen d marra imɣaren n řgens zemmaren ad cehden belli ksiɣ tibratin i tawmat, maḥend ad ruḥeɣ ɣar Dimacq ḥima ad awyeɣ inni din iǧan ɛawed s tcarfin ɣar Urcalim, ḥima ad ṭṭfen lɛiqab.
Umi d ayi tuɣa deg webrid uca iwḍeɣ ɣar Dimacq ɣar wezyen n wass, tařɣa xafi s řɣefřet ict n tfawt temɣar zeg ujenna.
Wḍiɣ x temmurt, sřiɣ ict n tmijja, teqqar ayi: ‘Cawul, Cawul, mayemmi d ayi tdarrced?’
Arriɣ-dd xas: ‘Min teɛnid Cek, a Sidi?’ Inna ayi: ‘Necc d Yasuɛ, Nnaṣiri, wenni tᵉttdarraced!’
Iryazen nni tuɣa iǧan akidi, ẓrin tafawt, maca war sřin ca i tmijja n Wenni akidi issawařen.
Nniɣ: ‘Min ɣa ggeɣ, a Sidi?’ Inna ayi Siditneɣ: ‘Kkar, traḥed ɣar Dimacq, din ad ac ittwanna x marra min d ac yuran ad tegged!’
Umi dewřeɣ war ttwiřiɣ zi tissiqt n tfawt nni, gewwden ayi inni i tuɣa akidi iǧan zeg ufus, uca ammu i dd-iwḍeɣ ɣar Dimacq.
Tuɣa din ijj weryaz, qqaren as Ananiyas. Netta d amsegged ɛlaḥsab Ccariɛa, am mammec tuɣa xas cehhden marra Udayen.
Netta yusa-dd ɣari, inna ayi: ‘A uma Cawul, arzem tiṭṭawin nnec!’ Řexdenni di tsaɛɛet nni ttwarzment tiṭṭawin inu, uca ẓriɣ t.
Netta inna ayi: ‘Aqa AREBBI n řejdud nneɣ ixḍar i cek, ḥima ad tessned min ixs Netta, u ḥima ad tẓared Amseggad, ad tesřed tmijja nnes zeg uqemmum nnes.
Cek ad as tiřid d acehhad ɣar marra iwdan s marra min teẓrid u s min tesřid.
Iwa řexxu, mayemmi war tezɛimed ɛad? Kkar, ejj ad cek ssɣeḍṣen, ad tᵉttwasizedged zi ddnub nnec am tᵉttřaɣid x Yisem nnes!’
Awarni řami dd-ɛeqbeɣ, iwḍeɣ da ɣar Urcalim, uca am tuɣa ttẓaǧiɣ di Zzawect Tameqqrant,
ẓriɣ t deg ijj n řewḥiy, inna ayi: ‘Azzeř, teffɣed deɣya zi Urcalim minzi war qebbřen ca cchadet nnec xafi!’
Nniɣ necc: ‘A Sidi, aqa nitni ssnen belli tuɣa ttḥebbseɣ inni yumnen zzayek, hettkeɣ ten s urekkuḍ di temzidawin,
u řami ttwasizzřen idammen n ucehhad nnec Stifanus, tuɣa beddeɣ akidsen, arḍiɣ x yinni t nɣin u ḥḍiɣ arruḍ n yinni t yarejmen.’
Xenni inna ayi: ‘Ruḥ, minzi ad cek ssekkeɣ ɣar řaggʷaj ḥima ad tbarrḥed L’Injil i řegnus!’”
Tuɣa ttesřan as ař awař-a, xenni kkaren ssgeɛɛden tmijja nsen, qqaren: “Kksem t zi temmurt, minzi am wanita war isdiheǧ ad iddar.”
Am tuɣa sɣuyyun, neṭṭaren arruḍ nsen uca zuzzaran ucař ɣar ujenna.
Yumur ukumandar maḥend ad t ssidfen ɣar lqecla, ad t sseqsan am t tthettaken s urekkuḍ ḥima ad zzayes ifhem mayemmi xas sɣuyen ammu.
Umi t jebden s tḥezzamin i uhettek s urekkuḍ, inna Bulus i řqebṭan x mya i din ibedden: “Ma iḥeǧeř awem ɛlaḥsab ccariɛa nwem ad thettkem ijj n bnadem d Arumani s urekkuḍ am war xas teḥkimem ɛad?”
Umi isřa řqebṭan x mya man aya, iruḥ ɣar ukumandar, inna as: “Min ɣa tegged? Aqa aryaz-a d Arumani!”
Iqarreb-dd ɣares ukumandar, inna as: “Ini ayi, ma cek d Arumani?” Yarra-dd xas Bulus: “Wah!”
Yarra-dd xas ukumandar, inna: “Necc ṭṭfeɣ řḥeqq-a n umezdaɣ Arumani s ijj n řqedd d ameqqran n tmenyat!” Bulus inna: “Maca necc xeřqeɣ-dd zzayes!”
Řexdenni, inni tuɣa nwan ad t hettken s urekkud, jjin t. Akumandar idweř iggʷed, minzi ifhem aqa-t d Arumani u minzi ijja i-t ad t carfen.

Tiwecca nnes am tuɣa ixs ad issen tidett min xef t ḍeřmen Wudayen, igga ad fesyen iceddiyyen nnes uca yumur ad ssmunen izeǧifen n ikehhanen d marra Jmaɛet Tameqqrant n imeqqranen nsen uca issehwa-dd Bulus ɣar din, issbedd i-t di řwesṭ nsen.
